title: Tiered change-letter for Dedicated privacy upgrades — internal & customer handoff
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a two-tiered change-letter set to communicate Dedicated privacy and key-management upgrades: (1) a concise, non-technical customer-facing letter that highlights user impact, mitigation steps, and timeline; (2) an internal ops/solutions brief with rollout checklist, rollback plan, affected SLOs, and escalation contacts. Coordinate signoff across Legal, Security, Support, and Sales engineering before publishing.
timeline: 2026-03-05: Draft customer letter v0 and ops brief v0
2026-03-11: Revise per reviews and produce two-tier artifacts
2026-03-20: Publish customer letter and update docs after embargo window
acceptance_criteria: Customer letter <= 300 words for tier-1 customers and a 2-line summary for banner use
Internal ops brief contains: rollout checklist, monitoring queries, rollback steps, communication templates for Support
All stakeholders (Legal, Security, CS, Support, Sales Eng) have documented signoff in thread or PR
Linked PRs for doc updates merged and smoke-tested in staging
review_notes: 2026-03-06 (Priya): Requested removal of product roadmap language that could imply future commitments
2026-03-09 (Morgan): Confirmed KMS provider list and added requirement to include contact for HSM escalations
2026-03-10 (Diego): Asked for templated customer questions and suggested an FAQ section for billing/SLA queries
decisions: Keep customer letter intentionally short and link to an expanded FAQ hosted on docs.redwood
Delay mass email until the day after the public docs are live to ensure support has materials
Use a two-tier notification: banner for low-touch customers + targeted email for impacted contracts
next_steps: Finalize the customer letter and FAQ links and circulate for final signoff by 2026-03-14
Create Support playbook with canned responses and escalation flow (owner: Hannah Chen)
Schedule a 30-minute sync with Sales Eng to prepare targeted account list for personal outreach
Prepare an internal Slack announcement with pinned ops-brief and runbook
risks: Support could be overwhelmed if estimated impacted accounts is undercounted
Legal review could require rewrites that delay publish date
A last-minute rollback in the runtime could change messaging and require retraction
notes_history: 2026-03-01 Kickoff: agreed to two-tier approach to minimize legal exposure and reduce support lift
2026-03-05 Draft: initial customer letter biased toward technical detail — trimmed per PM feedback
communication_channels: Customer Success weekly syncs for enterprise accounts
